title: Slide
desc_lfm_album: Slide is the second album by American electronic musician George Clanton, released on August 17, 2018 by his independent record label 100% Electronica. After releasing his debut album 100% Electronica, George Clanton tried to produce a sequel to it for three years but found it difficult because he wasn't able to find the sound he wanted for it. After giving up, he started experimenting and writing stuff for fun and felt that the "songs themselves". This material became the basis for Slide. Clanton said that Slide was the first album he wrote under his own name, since his debut album .
desc_lfm_artist: Formerly known as Mirror Kisses, and also known under the moniker ESPRIT 空想, George Clanton has decided to finally go by his own name and merge the two personas into one project, combining the vocal and New Wave/Chillwave elements from Mirror Kisses with the ethereal, hazy and lo-fi Vaporwave elements of ESPRIT 空想, which results in an absolutely beautiful new sound altogether. On his 2015 album, 100% Electronica, Clanton's warm and glistening synths glide over immensely satisfyingly punchy percussion

title: 100% Electronica
desc_lfm_album: 100% Electronica is the debut album by American vaporwave/synthpop artist George Clanton, released on September 25, 2015 on 100% Electronica. 100% Electronica was recorded in Richmond VA and Ridgewood NY between 2014 & 2015. All recording, mixing and “mastering” was performed by George Clanton on a fake Mac Pro and a Fostex Model 80 reel to reel. .

title: Visions
desc_lfm_album: Visions is the third studio album by Canadian musician Grimes. It was released through 4AD on February 21, 2012. Her first since signing with 4AD, the album was recorded entirely on Apple's GarageBand software in Grimes' apartment over a three-week period. It was mixed by Grimes and her manager, Sebastian Cowan, at their La Brique Studio Space in Montreal. Visions was streamed on the NPR website a week before it was released in the United States. "Visions" was acclaimed by music critics and was included in several year-end lists. The album's two singles, "Oblivion" and "Genesis", were named among the .
desc_lfm_artist:
Claire Elise Boucher, known professionally as Grimes, is a Canadian musician, singer, songwriter, record producer, music video director and visual artist. Her music incorporates elements of varied styles and genres including dream pop, synth-pop, art pop, electronic, experimental pop, R&B and hip hop.

Throughout her career, she has released five studio albums, two extended plays, eleven singles, and four promotional singles.

title: VEGA INTL. Night School
desc_lfm_album: VEGA INTL. Night School is the third album by American electronic music band Neon Indian. It was announced on August 13, 2015, and was released on October 16, 2015. The album title is an intentional nod to Alan Palomo's other music project entitled VEGA, for which he has produced only a single EP. Upon noticing that ideas from both Neon Indian and VEGA were merging, Palomo decided to combine the two projects into one and retire the use of the VEGA moniker. These facts can allow one to consider the album as the de facto debut album as well as .
desc_lfm_artist:
Neon Indian is a chillwave band from Denton, Texas. The group is the current project of musician Alan Palomo, also known for his work with the band Ghosthustler and as the artist VEGA. The group has released three studio albums: "Psychic Chasms" (2009), "Era Extraña" (2011), and "VEGA INTL. Night School" (2015).

The band began to garner attention in 2009 after several of their songs which had been posted online were favorably reviewed by music blogs and Web sites. On October 13, 2009, the group released its debut LP Psychic Chasms.

title: Odyssey
desc_lfm_album: Odyssey is Home's second album, released on July 1, 2014. It contains twelve tracks, ranging from three to five minutes in length, with the exception of the titular track "Odyssey", which is over six minutes. The album was released in 2016 as a physical black vinyl disc before selling out. It featured all the original songs, alternative artwork, and 5 previously unreleased demos as bonus tracks to conclude the album. It was later re-released as a translucent orange vinyl, which also sold out. The five bonus tracks are entitled "Flatline", "Heading Up", "Oracle", "Rains", "Soak" and "Somewhere in Silence". .
